28 Kasım 2014 Cuma 21:40:03 UTC+2 tarihinde Seongho Bae yazdı:
Find out this:

Kline, R. B. (2011). Principles and practice of structural equation modeling. Guilford press.

DWLS with scaled.shifted test (a.k.a. WLSMV) may better for categorical data like likert type scale when use ordered option in lavaan. Cheers.

--
Seongho

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Sample Size in SEM
parts:
Best guide for choosing sample size is a power analysis, probably based on simulation.  This is rather easy to accomplish these days, with the tools available in R.  Old rules of thumb, from the literature 40 years ago, at best were based on anecdote, and at worst were anti-scientific, either self-serving for the authors or aimed at helping other researchers to minimize the risk that their model would be rejected.
--Ed Rigdon

Sent from my iPad
